name: ein
description: Root-only MCP transport to this named Ein external executor. Use start only after the user explicitly delegates a bounded scope to this executor. Never choose or start an executor automatically. Resume on the SAME session is the required transport continuation for decisions/corrections/evidence within that already-authorized scope.

action.description: start/resume return STARTING/RUNNING without blocking conversation. Only root calls actions. ESCALATE returns to root and continuation goes back through resume on the SAME session. No automatic polling; status/messages/wait only on explicit user request or recovery. cancel is explicit abandonment of active execution.

plan_path.description: For start: existing self-contained implementation plan path inside the workspace. Use either plan_path or prompt, not both.

session_id.description: For resume/cancel/status/messages/wait: Harr session id returned by a prior start. Resume must target the SAME session for the delegated scope.

prompt.description: For start: self-contained execution contract with goal, bounded scope, fixed decisions/constraints, acceptance criteria, and required validation. For resume: only the complete delta for the SAME session (decision/correction, invariants, disposition of existing edits when relevant, acceptance/validation delta).

timeout_sec.description: For start/resume: optional hard wall-clock limit in seconds. 0 (default) means unlimited. Any nonnegative integer accepted.

wait_timeout_sec.description: Only for explicitly desired blocking wait: default/max 1500s (25min). Never short-loop polling. Timeout returns RUNNING/STARTING and does not cancel or release scope ownership.

after_revision.description: For messages: return assistant progress messages newer than this revision. Omit to return the latest messages.

message_limit.description: For messages: maximum number of assistant progress messages to return. Default 8.
